steps.title: Gather materials and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect all listed items: polypropylene round‑bottom tubes with snap caps (BD catalog BD352063), polypropylene centrifuge tubes (Greiner catalog 188271), cover slides, 5‑, 10‑, and 25‑mL pipettes, micropipettes with tips, T75 flasks (Falcon catalog 353136), normal human dermal fibroblasts (NHDFs, Promocell catalog C‑12300), Fibroblast Growth Medium‑2 BulletKit™ (Lonza catalog cc‑3132), Trypsin/EDTA (Gibco catalog R001‑100), Trypan blue (Gibco catalog 15250‑061), Trypsin neutralizer (Gibco catalog R002‑100), 5‑dodecanoylaminofluorescein di‑β‑D‑galactopyranoside (C12 FDG, Invitrogen catalog D2893) and a 20 mM stock in DMSO, pre‑sort buffer (BD catalog BD 563503, keep at 4 °C one day before), heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum (FBS, Eurobio catalog CVFSVF00‑0U, 56 °C for 30 min), and sterile DPBS (no Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺, Gibco catalog 14190‑144).

steps.title: Culture NHDFs and subculture
steps.instruction: Maintain NHDFs at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, atmospheric O₂ in fibroblast growth medium‑2 (160 µL cm⁻²). Subculture before 70 % confluence: rinse with Trypsin/EDTA (TE) pre‑warmed to 37 °C, add TE at 40 µL cm⁻², incubate 5 min for exponentially growing cells or 10 min for cells at the senescence plateau, then add an equal volume of Trypsin neutralizer (TN) pre‑warmed to 37 °C. Collect cells, centrifuge 90 × g for 5 min at room temperature, and re‑plate at 3 500 cells cm⁻² (exponential) or 2 000 cells cm⁻² (senescent). Freeze early‑passage cells for use as negative controls a few days before sorting.

steps.title: Prepare C12 FDG staining solution
steps.instruction: Dilute C12 FDG stock (20 mM in DMSO) in culture medium pre‑warmed to 37 °C to obtain a final concentration of 33 µM for NHDFs. For unstained controls, dilute the same volume of DMSO in pre‑warmed medium.

steps.title: Stain cells with C12 FDG
steps.instruction: Add the 33 µM C12 FDG solution to cells at 100 µL cm⁻² and incubate 2 h at 37 °C. For unstained controls, add the DMSO‑containing medium at the same volume and incubate 2 h at 37 °C. Perform staining in the dark to avoid photobleaching. Verify staining quality under an inverted epifluorescence microscope; high concentrations or long incubations may be toxic.

steps.title: Harvest cells in dark
steps.instruction: All following steps are performed in darkness. Remove C12 FDG‑ or DMSO‑containing medium, rinse cells twice with 30 µL cm⁻² sterile DPBS at room temperature, discard DPBS, then add Trypsin/EDTA pre‑warmed to 37 °C at 40 µL cm⁻² and incubate until cells detach (incubation time may be ~50 % longer for senescent cells). Neutralize with an equal volume of Trypsin neutralizer pre‑warmed to 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells for sorting
steps.instruction: Count the cells, centrifuge at 90 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, rinse pellet with 500 µL cold pre‑sort buffer, centrifuge again at 90 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and finally resuspend in cold pre‑sort buffer to 4 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹. Keep tubes on ice until sorting to protect the fluorescent SA‑β‑Gal product.

steps.title: Prepare sorting tubes with FBS
steps.instruction: Fill pre‑sorting and post‑sorting polypropylene tubes with FBS that has been heat‑inactivated at 56 °C for 30 min. Incubate tubes for 30 min at 37 °C to allow coating. Cool the tubes to 4 °C using a circulating water‑cooling device before use.

steps.title: Set up flow cytometer
steps.instruction: Configure a BD INFLUX V7 (or equivalent) equipped with a 200 µm nozzle. Set acquisition for forward scatter (FSC), side scatter (SSC), and C12 FDG fluorescence using the 530/40 nm FITC filter with a 488 nm laser, following the manufacturer’s instructions. Tune sorting parameters to the 200 µm nozzle (e.g., sheath pressure 3.7 psi). Cool pre‑ and post‑sorting tubes to 4 °C.

steps.title: Define sorting gates
steps.instruction: Analyze FSC vs. SSC of unstained early‑passage and senescent NHDFs to set scale and amplification. Create four gates: (1) debris exclusion using FSC/SSC; (2) singlet gate using FSC‑width vs. FSC‑area (draw a large gate to retain high FSC‑W singlet cells); (3) C12 FDG‑high gate by comparing fluorescence of stained senescent cells to unstained senescent and stained early‑passage cells; (4) within the C12 FDG‑high population, gate FSC‑high/SSC‑high cells. Adjust stringency as needed and keep gates non‑adjacent if subpopulations are to be separated.

steps.title: Perform cell sorting
steps.instruction: Sort C12 FDG‑high/FSC‑high/SSC‑high cells using the parameters in Table 1: nozzle 200 µm, sheath pressure 3.7 psi, piezo amplitude 4.01, drop delay 15.6711, sort mode Drop Pure, drop envelope 1.0, sort objective Phase mask, extra coincidence bits 1.0, drop frequency 6.30 kHz. Run at 500–1 000 events s⁻¹ (up to 2 000 events s⁻¹ if needed). Verify deflection stream stability with unstained senescent cells by covering the collecting tube with a cover slide and confirming the drop lands at the center. Collect sorted cells at 4 °C in the circulating water‑cooling device.

steps.title: Collect sorted cells for downstream use
steps.instruction: Keep the sorted cell suspension at 4 °C and proceed directly to downstream applications such as protein extraction or replating for further experiments.
